_about: Client Satisfaction Measurement (CSM) form shown to clients on their request page.
Follows the Legal Office's printed Client Satisfaction Measurement form (Version 1, effective May 10, 2023;
manuscript Appendix E), which is based on the ARTA harmonized CSM. Choices are listed from Strongly disagree
to Strongly agree (manuscript Figure 9.3). The printed form's name, sex, age, client type and email blanks are
left out: no new personal data is collected, and the client type and service come from the request.
To change the form: edit this file, keep valid JSON, and change "version" so old answers stay apart.
Question ids and choice values are saved with each answer; do not reuse an id for a different question.
Answers count as satisfied when their value is in the scale's "satisfied_values" (ARTA: Agree + Strongly Agree).
title: Client Satisfaction Measurement
intro: Help us serve you better! This Client Satisfaction Measurement (CSM) tracks the customer experience of government offices. Your feedback on your recently concluded transaction will help this office provide a better service. Personal information shared will be kept confidential and you always have the option to not answer this form. Your answers are seen only as totals: the Legal Office does not see how each client answered.

sections.heading: Citizen's Charter
sections.instructions: The Citizen's Charter (CC) is an official document that reflects the services of a government agency/office including its requirements, fees, and processing times among others.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your awareness of a CC?

options.label: 1. I know what a CC is and I saw this office's CC.
2. I know what a CC is but I did NOT see this office's CC.
3. I learned of the CC only when I saw this office's CC.
4. I do not know what a CC is and I did not see one in this office. (Answer N/A on CC2 and CC3)

questions.text: If aware of CC (answered 1-3 in CC1), would you say that the CC of this office was ...?
If aware of CC (answered codes 1-3 in CC1), how much did the CC help you in your transaction?

sections.heading: Service quality
sections.instructions: For SQD 0-8, please choose the answer that best corresponds to each statement.

questions.text: I am satisfied with the service that I availed.
I spent a reasonable amount of time for my transaction.
The office followed the transaction's requirements and steps based on the information provided.
The steps (including payment) I needed to do for my transaction were easy and simple.
I easily found information about my transaction from the office or its website.
I paid a reasonable amount of fees for my transaction.
I feel the office was fair to everyone, or "walang palakasan", during my transaction.
I was treated courteously by the staff, and (if asked for help) the staff was helpful.
I got what I needed from the government office or (if denied) denial of request was sufficiently explained to me.

comment.label: Suggestions on how we can further improve our services (optional)
